module_summary: ARP frame transmitter: latches parallel ARP header fields on a valid/ready handshake, then a pointer-driven serializer emits the 28-byte ARP payload onto AXI-stream through a skid output buffer.

anchors.name: s_frame_valid
anchors.why: Input frame valid; with s_frame_ready triggers header field capture.

anchors.name: s_frame_ready
anchors.why: Frame ready, high when no header pending or payload being sent.

anchors.name: send_arp_header_reg
anchors.why: Two-state controller: set on frame accept, cleared after last header byte.

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Byte/word pointer selecting which ARP header field is emitted each cycle.

anchors.name: store_frame
anchors.why: Load enable latching all input ARP and Ethernet header fields.

anchors.name: arp_sha_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched ARP header field held while payload is serialized.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid, set on frame accept, cleared by m_eth_hdr_ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready that clears header valid.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Latched Ethernet destination MAC driving output header field.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Serialized header byte lanes selected by ptr_reg before output buffer.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-stream payload output carrying serialized ARP header bytes.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output AXI-stream valid from the output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready steering skid buffer transfers and internal ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker set on the final header byte.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready gating header serialization and output buffer loading.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data register used when output stalls.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp register occupancy flag controlling early ready and output refill.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal payload directly into the output register.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads internal payload into temp register when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp register contents into output register.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level output mirroring header transmission in progress.

groups.name: Header capture
groups.description: Latches ARP and Ethernet header fields on accepted frame.

groups.name: Header serializer control
groups.description: Send flag and pointer sequence the 28-byte header emission and input ready.

groups.name: Payload byte mux
groups.description: Selects header bytes into AXI lanes per ptr_reg, sets tkeep and tlast.

groups.name: Ethernet header output
groups.description: Header valid/ready handshake presenting latched MAC addresses and ethertype.

groups.name: AXI output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers decoupling payload from downstream tready stalls.
